english_text: O Allah, pour curses upon all of them.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَعَلَىٰ ٱلأَرْوَاحِ ٱلَّتِي حَلَّتْ بِفِنَائِكَ
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka yā aba ʿabdillāh. wa ʿalā al-arwāḥi allatī hallat bifināʾik.
english_text: Peace be upon you, O Abu-`Abdullah and upon the souls that gathered in your courtyard.

arabic_text: عَلَيْكَ مِنِّي سَلاَمُ ٱللَّهِ أَبَداً مَا بَقيتُ وَبَقِيَ ٱللَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ
transliteration: ʿAlayka minnī salāmu Allahi abadan. mā baqītu wa baqiya l-laylu wa n-nahāru.
english_text: Peace of Allah be upon you from me forever as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.

arabic_text: وَلاَ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنِّي لِزِيَارَتِكُمْ
transliteration: walā jaʿalahu allāhu ākhira al-ʿahdi minnī liziyāratikum.
english_text: May Allah not cause this (visit) to be the last of my visit to you (all).

arabic_text: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ وَعَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ وَعَلَىٰ أَوْلاَدِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ وَعَلَىٰ أَصْحَابِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
transliteration: as-salāmu ʿalā al-ḥusayn. wa ʿalā ʿalī ibn al-ḥusayn. wa ʿalā awlād al-ḥusayn. wa ʿalā aṣḥābi al-ḥusayn.
english_text: Peace be upon al-Husayn, upon `Ali ibn al-Husayn, upon the sons of al-Husayn, and upon the companions of al-Husayn.
and upon the companions of al-Husayn.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ خُصَّ أَنْتَ أَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ بِٱللَّعْنِ مِنِّي وَٱبْدَأْ بِهِ أَوَّلًا ثُمَّ ٱلْعَنِ ٱلثَّانِيَ وَٱلثَّالِثَ وَٱلرَّابِعَ
transliteration: allāhumma khuṣṣa anta awwala dhālimin bi-l-la'ni minnī. wa'ibda' bihi awwalan. thumma al'ani alththaniya walththalitha waarrrabi'a.
english_text: O Allah, pour special curses on the foremost persecutor and begin with him first, and then pour curses on the second, the third, and the fourth.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱلْعَنْ يَزِيدَ خَامِساً وَٱلْعَنْ عُبَيْدَ ٱللَّهِ بْنَ زِيَادٍ وَٱبْنَ مَرْجَانَةَ وَعُمَرَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ وَشِمْراً وَآلَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ وَآلَ زِيَادٍ وَآلَ مَرْوَانَ
transliteration: allahumma al'an yazid khamesan. wa al'an ʿubayd allāh ibn ziyād wa ibn marjānah. waʿumar ibn saʿd wa shimran. wa āla abī sufyan wa āla ziyād wa āla marwāna.
english_text: O Allah, curse Yazid fifthly, and curse `Ubaydullah ibn Ziyad, the son of Marjanah, `Umar ibn Sa`d, Shimr, the family of Abu-Sufyan, the family of Ziyad, and the family of Marwan
O Allah, all praise be to You;
the praise of those who thank You for their misfortunes.
All praise be to Allah for my great misfortune.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱرْزُقْنِي شَفَاعَةَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ يَوْمَ ٱلْوُرُودِ وَثَبِّتْ لِي قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَكَ مَعَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ وَأَصْحَابِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
transliteration: allāhumma arzuqnī shafāʿata al-ḥusayn yawm al-wurūd. wa thabbit li qadam sidqin 'indaka. maʿa al-ḥusayn wa-ashābi al-ḥusayn.
english_text: O Allah, (please) grant me the intercession of al-Husayn on the Day of Coming (to You) and make for me with You a firm step of honesty with al-Husayn and the companions of al-Husayn
